profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Wells Fargo
profile.summary: Skilled in modernizing legacy applications to new technology stacks such as Java, Spring Boot and Angular with migration to microservices using Pivotal Cloud Foundry.  I've led software development teams distributed across the US and India as an Agile Product Owner.  Experienced working with business partners and the software delivery team to manage the backlog and identifying tasks that can be completed in a sprint.  As a senior lead engineer, I support the teams through leading troubleshooting sessions and recognizing the importance of work life balance.  Knowledgeable in integration with GitHub, Jenkins, Urban Code Deploy and Splunk.  I promote efficient software delivery through simplification and automation of the Software Development Life Cycle process.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Full Stack software development in an Agile team environment, modernizing applications that support mortgage securitization within Wells Fargo Home Mortgage and Capital Markets.  I lead distributed teams, both as a Product Owner as well as a hands-on engineer, through software development using Java, Spring Boot and Angular to code, test and deliver solutions using continuous integration and delivery.  Experience with Pivotal Cloud Foundry, creating RESTful APIs as well as working with the APIs for JIRA, GitHub, Jenkins and Urban Code Deploy to implement automation.
positions.insights: Spring Boot, Oracle SQL Developer and +4 skills

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Develop intranet web application software using Java, Struts, Spring and JavaScript with Eclipse for the primary application used in Wells Fargo Financial consumer finance stores.  The platform is built on Apache Tomcat and Vignette portal.
• Code solutions for projects and change requests, resolve daily defects, review and contribute to preparation of analysis and design documents, assist with and review stress testing and provide on-call support.
• Write code to process XML messages transmitted through existing web services for access to data on Oracle servers and multiple systems of record.
• Perform daily build process using ANT and CVS.  Troubleshoot build problems and either correct the problem or contact appropriate support team to ensure timely deployment is made.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Performed as a Design Lead for the conversions of WFF Bank Cards and WFF Retail Sales Finance to First Data Resources credit card system.
• Collaborated with project management and development teams to design solutions based on architectural guidelines and best practices.
• Received Service Excellence Award and Gold Coin Award for enabling our team to complete key artifacts for audit and Enterprise Architecture oversight.
• Developed extensive data repository of hardware/software inventories and transaction volumes utilized for creating system diagrams for network capacity planning.
• Accomplished tasks with Sparx Enterprise Architect, Visio, Excel and VBA.
positions.insights: Visual Basic for Applications (VBA), Enterprise Architecture and +1 skill

positions.title: Technical Support Analyst
positions.description:
• Provided technical support for PCs, printers and network.
• Prepared macros for WordPerfect and Lotus 123 to automate data collection and reporting.
• Provided backup support for data processing and reporting tasks on mainframe.
• Maintained IBM 3274 controller configurations.

positions.title: Computer Programmer
positions.description:
• Developed application software using PICK Basic on a Stratus mainframe for mail order warehouse and retail sales applications.
• Designed and implemented bar coded inventory labeling and scanning system used in the retail stores.

positions.title: Computer Operator
positions.description: • Performed JCL execution and report printing on System 36.
